recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If a future package build drops the version suffix on required code binding ValueSet canonicals, fix the generation/publisher path rather than bulk-editing raw StructureDefinition source inputs.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I request for STU3/R4 generation to make bindings for code elements version-specific in final packages by including the FHIR version in the canonical ValueSet reference.
initial_application: Jira cites GH#7dad348872; commit 7dad348872e99ca452ec098076d3d7bef3117d03 changed the then-current ProfileGenerator to append |version to required binding ValueSet references and is an ancestor of both the worker and combined branches.
additional_context: Raw source StructureDefinition inputs commonly retain unversioned ValueSet canonicals, but FHIR-19595 targeted final generation. Current terminology guidance describes required code bindings as static/version-specific, current CI generated JSON includes |6.0.0-ballot4 suffixes for representative code bindings, and R4/R5 publications include |4.0.1 and |5.0.0 suffixes. A 2018 FMG Zulip R4-preparation thread corroborates the same R4 task. FHIR-38967 later improved terminology examples and is already represented separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical generation-path fix is present, the current final generated package surface satisfies the Jira request, and editing raw source inputs would be the wrong layer for this issue.

related_jiras.note: Later terminology binding examples work documents required/static binding examples and is already represented on the combined branch; it is not part of this FHIR-19595 decision.
